title: Feature messages and illustration pairs
slide_intent: Pair a benefit with a visual metaphor because a person should understand the offer and remember its tone.
strategic_value: Unexpected drawings beside plain feature messages can make Mailchimp’s tools feel useful without losing personality.
demonstration: Eleven held frames pair large serif messages with black drawings on white, including email, integration, testing and automation examples.
practical_value: Compare how literal product language and surreal imagery share a message.

content_islands.name: Message
content_islands.spec: Place each feature phrase in large black serif type with generous white space.

content_islands.name: Metaphor
content_islands.spec: Pair the phrase with a drawing whose subject or action relates to that feature.

reference_purposes.Application: The sequence demonstrates different feature messages paired with illustrations.
reference_purposes.Expression: Black irregular drawings accompany consistent serif headlines.
